about_the_game:
A critical notice from the Bureau of Liberty and Individual Safety (B.L.I.S.)

Recent disturbances and abnormal phenomena have been detected in your area. For your safety and well-being, all individuals must remain inside their homes. Under no circumstances should you look outside. Keep all doors locked and windows shut.

DO NOT LOOK OUTSIDE. DO NOT GO OUTSIDE.

Some citizens have reported symptoms due to extended isolation, including:

  • Dry mouth

  • Blurred Vision

  • Irregular heart rhythm

  • Elevated blood pressure

  • Paranoia

  • Sightings of Angels

These symptoms are normal and will worsen if instructions are not followed.

To minimize these symptoms:

  • Keep a well-lit environment

  • Ensure all windows remain shut

  • Avoid visual contact with the outside

  • Avoid visual contact with the Angels

B.L.I.S. thanks you for your cooperation. Re-read this message carefully.

  • OS: MacOs 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 (4th gen) or Apple M1
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel Iris Plus / AMD Radeon Pro 555 / Apple M1 GPU
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
mac_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: macOS 12
  • Processor: Apple M1/M2 or Intel Core i7
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: AMD Radeon Pro 560X / Apple M1 Pro
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
